items.title: Cech cohomology of an injective module is concentrated in degree zero
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Cech cohomology of an injective module over a ringed site with respect to an arbitrary covering: it is I(U) in degree zero and vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 1815-1830). The proof rewrites the Cech groups through the description by maps from representable objects (proof lines 1832-1845) and then uses the extension property of injective modules to kill the higher groups (proof lines 1845-1855), the degree zero case following from the same description (proof lines 1855-1859). The non-formal content is the use of injectivity in the form of extendability of compatible families. The claim is H2: one identification plus one extension argument.
